audit.feedback: editorial_review_rejected: Card1 shows a real dark-feathered ostrich standing in a park/zoo enclosure with trees and fencing - matches the 'largest bird' info card. Card2 is Muybridge's classic black-and-white motion-study grid of an ostrich running, correctly used only to illustrate leg mechanics, not presented as a specific historical event. Card4 shows a single ostrich walking across sand dunes in a desert landscape - reasonable generic illustration for the 'returned to Saudi reserves' card. However Card3's image (a 19th-century still-life painting) is dominated by a bowl of peaches; the supposed 'ostrich egg' is a small, mostly obscured egg-shaped decorative object under a lid on the left side, not recognizable as an ostrich egg from the pixels alone. Since the card's point is the egg's size comparison to chicken eggs, an obscured, ambiguous egg-shaped object fails the visual relevance test, so that card is marked not relevant and visual_identity is set to false.

visual_review_rejected: Card 3's photo is a 19th‑century still‑life of peaches in a basket; the claimed 'ostrich egg' is a small cream‑colored, domed vessel tucked in the background, dominated by the peaches. It is not recognizable as an ostrich egg from the pixels alone (looks like a lidded cup/vase), so the subject is ambiguous/obscured and fails the visual‑identification bar for the '24 chicken eggs' claim. All other cards check out: card 1 shows a clearly identifiable live ostrich matching the size/speed facts; card 2 is Muybridge's historical motion study of a running ostrich, appropriately used to illustrate the wing/leg mechanics text, not presented as a current photo; card 4 shows a small but clearly recognizable ostrich walking across a desert dune landscape, fitting the habitat-return story. Text on every card matches the sourced claims (speed, height, weight, egg weight, wing function, reintroduction), phrasing is natural Saudi colloquial, progression from general facts to flight quirk to egg fact to reintroduction story is coherent and distinct, and the Almarai-brand light template is consistent throughout. Because of the mismatched image on card 3, the package should be rejected pending a correct ostrich-egg photo.
